help_spectrum: Colour box that opens a picker with a saturation square and a hue bar. Writes an RGB string, three channels or hue/saturation/lightness.
help_homematic: The colour of a Homematic RGBW light: one number from 0 to 199 on the colour circle, 200 is white.
help_farbtastic: Colour wheel in the widget: the ring sets the hue, the square inside saturation and lightness.
help_rgb_color: A label with a colour box. The picker writes while the colour is dragged, as the jscolor widget did.
help_hue_color: Button that opens the colour field of a Philips HUE light, with a brightness slider. Writes one command to the lamp.
help_hue_picker_xy: The colour field of a Philips HUE light, as large as the widget. A click sets the colour of the lamp.
help_hue_indicator_xy: Shows the colour a Philips HUE light is set to. Only reads, does not switch anything.
help_hue_picker_ct: Bar from warm to cold white. A click sets the colour temperature of the lamp.
help_hue_indicator_ct: Shows the white temperature a light is set to. Only reads, does not switch anything.
command_oid_tooltip: The command state of the lamp, e.g. hue.0.Lamp.command. The other fields are filled in from the lamp.
xy_oid_tooltip: State with the colour point of the lamp, like "0.4,0.4".
gamut_tooltip: Gamut A, B or C, or the model of the lamp (LCT001 etc.). Empty shows all colours.
transition_time_tooltip: How long the lamp takes for the change, in tenths of a second. 4 is the default of the HUE API.
factor_tooltip: The states are multiplied by this when they are read and divided by it when they are written - e.g. 255 for channels that run from 0 to 1.
decimal_tooltip: Digits after the comma of the written values.
title: Title
inline_tooltip: Shows the picker instead of the colour box, filling the whole widget. Give the widget enough room for it.
ct_unit_tooltip: How the state holds the colour temperature. A Philips HUE light uses mired, many other adapters Kelvin.
ct_min_tooltip: The warm end of the bar, in Kelvin. 2000 K is what a Philips HUE light can do.
ct_max_tooltip: The cold end of the bar, in Kelvin. 6500 K is what a Philips HUE light can do.
